description: This file defines a C# interface ICustomerGrain within the Orleans framework, specifying methods for customer-related operations in a grain.

classes.name: ICustomerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for customer operations, identified by an integer key.

methods.name: IntroduceSelf
methods.description: Returns a string introducing the customer.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets customer details such as id, first name, and last name.

methods.name: AddDevice
methods.description: Associates a device grain with the customer.

methods.name: SetRandomState
methods.description: Sets a random internal state for the grain.
